source: survival you fish you hunt and you build a shelter with wood planks and metal while running from zombies

image_prompt.text: Open buildable ground where the player raises a shelter out of wood planks and sheet metal
a river or lake open enough to fish from the bank

layout_placement.text: Gatherable wood and metal for the shelter, plus fish and game taken from the water and the woods
Where zombies enter the world and the ground they roam, so the player is chased while gathering

notes: Biome world routes P4: the water, the woods, and the build area are separate regions rather than one framed surface.
Fishing water and huntable animals had no option and were carried as free text in the image stream.

open_questions.ask: Theme was inferred from the zombies alone — should this look post-apocalyptic and overgrown, or is it a normal wilderness that happens to have zombies in it?
Is this one wilderness you can cross on foot, or a large open world with distant biomes?

coverage_missing.ask: Post-apocalyptic and derelict, or ordinary wilderness with zombies?
How far apart are the water, the woods, and the shelter ground?
Is there a win — outlast a night, escape — or is it open-ended survival?

answers.ask: Theme was inferred from the zombies alone — should this look post-apocalyptic and overgrown, or is it a normal wilderness that happens to have zombies in it?
answers.answer: Make it post-apocalyptic and overgrown, with abandoned remnants around the wilderness to support the zombie survival setting.

answers.ask: Is this one wilderness you can cross on foot, or a large open world with distant biomes?
answers.answer: Use one small wilderness map that players can cross on foot; keep it focused on the core fishing, hunting, shelter-building, and zombie survival loop.
